source_title: How to Predict the Future-The Pokepreet Podcast ft. Professor Jiang Xueqin
summary: This interview extends Living School, Eschatology, Power As Alchemy, Strategy Material Test, and Mass Society by tying Jiang's psychohistory method to a non-secular world model where spiritual hunger, monetary belief, sacred empire, and hardened structural forces become predictive variables.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Prediction is a loop of building models, making predictions, and refining the model when reality proves it wrong.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The interview gives a clean public-facing restatement of psychohistory as model testing: read, travel, break assumptions, make predictions, and refine the analytical model.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Material geopolitics and eschatology align when Iran becomes both corridor pivot and sacred hinge.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source directly states the Eschatology page's basic rule: end-times stories are not decorative beliefs when they converge with corridors, enemies, and geopolitical plans.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Money exists because belief makes the symbol real, leaving central bankers to function like a new high priest class.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The money-as-imagination and dollar-habit sequence supports Power As Alchemy's claim that a symbolic object can become the real world people work inside.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Iran is not Iraq: air defenses, ballistic missiles, mountain terrain, and civilizational will make shock-and-awe fantasy fail the material test.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Iran forecast supplies a concrete material-audit cluster: terrain, weapons, morale, logistics, trade geography, and prior doctrine all test whether the imperial story can be executed.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the 2025-10-18 Pokepreet interview as the public-method recurrence: Jiang presents psychohistory as a teachable discipline whose prediction loop requires reading, travel, assumption-breaking, admitting error, and model refinement rather than pundit instinct.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Living School owns the formation and method: reading, travel, assumption-breaking, prediction, and model correction. Truth-as-predictive-coherence remains the held epistemic seed; Game Theory owns player-payoff analysis after a model names the game.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add this interview as a cross-imperial sacred-script comparison: America acts through defensive empire and Manifest Destiny, Russia through Orthodox Third Rome identity, Israel through Greater Israel, and Christian Zionists through return-of-Jesus acceleration, while China appears as the countercase of regime stability without the same outward sacred mission.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns the role-script and sacred-geography layer. Nation owns the state body that executes it; Strategy owns whether the military and trade geography make the script executable.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the central-banker-priest and dollar-habit sequence to deepen the monetary-belief layer: money has force because belief makes it real, the central bank becomes priestly because it manages that belief, and BRICS cannot easily replace the dollar because world habit keeps the symbolic order inhabited.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns money as belief-made reality and habit. Strategy owns coercive enforcement of the dollar order; Bureaucracy owns central-bank procedure only when the institutional maintenance itself is the mechanism.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Treat the Iran discussion as an interview-pressure recurrence of the anti-shock-and-awe audit: a U.S. ground invasion must survive Iranian air defense, drones, ballistic missiles, mountainous terrain, prepared civilizational morale, trade chokepoints, and escalation momentum.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns the material audit of invasion and chokepoint control. Eschatology owns the sacred reasons actors keep returning to Iran; Power As Alchemy owns dollar and finance effects.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the determinism answer as a compact 2025 formulation of mass society hardening: young open societies can choose theories of government, but mature mass society gives structural forces a life of their own through vested interests, elite overproduction, stagnation, and narrowed outcomes.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Mass Society owns scale and hardened structural constraint. Living School owns the training that might preserve openness; Legitimacy Fiction owns the theory of government once it becomes an inhabitable order.

chronology_notes.note: On 2025-10-18 Jiang publicly restates psychohistory as model-building, prediction, failed-prediction correction, and personal analytical discipline; this sits after the 2024-06-13 classroom formulation and before the later 2026 dark-age thought-process interview.

The interview records a dated 2025-10-18 claim that U.S.-China rapprochement is more plausible than U.S.-Russia rapprochement because Russia frames America as Antichrist while China remains culturally Americanized and financially entangled with the dollar system.

The source preserves dated forecasts about U.S.-Iran conflict, second American civil war pressure, and China's managed decline; downstream ledger or canon work should keep them as 2025-10-18 claims rather than rewrite them as present-tense outcomes.
